store: the query-conditioned skill residual, cached for decision time
why: assess reads this at every dream. The live measure costs ~964s for 54 skills on CPU (one embed_router.route fire per claimed-task query, over the whole conceptric network), which is far too slow for an inline fitness call - so the measurement is banked here and refreshed deliberately, not recomputed per assess.
polarity: D1 PV-20260820T223000Z - HIGH residual = DEMANDS INVESTMENT. High R means the skill's own claimed tasks cannot route to it: invisible, which is not the same as unfit. The high end plays the role the high end of usage-count played.
refresh: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m laplace.engine.skill_residual --out rows_qc.json --sink /tmp/wire_sink.jsonl   then   PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import json; from laplace import assess; assess.write_residual_cache(json.load(open('rows_qc.json')), source='rows_qc.json')"
